name: István Kovács
bio:
István's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula One races with his father in their small village. He pursued mechanical engineering, specializing in precision machining. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local manufacturing plant before landing a role at a small racing outfit. His meticulous approach and dedication to quality quickly earned him a reputation as a reliable and skilled machinist.

He joined Iron Lynx five years ago, where he's become an invaluable member of the team. István takes immense pride in his work, constantly seeking ways to improve the performance and reliability of the components he crafts. While demanding of himself and others, he fosters a collaborative environment in the workshop. He believes in teamwork and knowledge sharing to achieve the best results.

What sets István apart is his ability to blend traditional machining techniques with modern technology. He's always eager to learn new software and tools, applying them to optimize designs and improve manufacturing processes. His commitment to innovation and precision makes him a highly sought-after machinist in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: István is of medium build with a focused and intent gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Insists on listening to classical music while working, claiming it improves his focus.
Has a collection of vintage calipers he keeps meticulously cleaned and calibrated.
